name: toc
description: A column of links to the headings on the page, with the one being read marked as the reader scrolls.

attributes.name: data-variant
attributes.description: The hue of the current link and its edge bar.

attributes.name: data-size
attributes.description: The text step, and the inset of each link with it.

attributes.name: data-numbered
attributes.description: Number the entries before their links, nested ones as 2.1, in the muted color.

children.description: The links, one per li, with role="list".
One entry, holding a link whose href is the id of a heading on this page.

tokens.name: --yeti-toc-scroll
tokens.description: How the page scrolls to a heading; also read by a nav with in-page links.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-text-muted
tokens.description: A link that is not the current one.

tokens.name: --yeti-toc-hover
tokens.description: The hover fill; transparent turns it off.

tokens.name: --yeti-space-xs
tokens.description: Gap between links, and their block padding.

tokens.name: --yeti-space-sm
tokens.description: The space step when data-size is absent.

tokens.name: --yeti-text-md
tokens.description: Text size when data-size is absent.

tokens.name: --yeti-border-width
tokens.description: The edge bar is three of them.

tokens.name: --yeti-duration-fast
tokens.description: How long the mark takes to move.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-primary
tokens.description: The default variant's color, when data-variant is absent.

a11y.notes: Give the nav an aria-label such as "On this page", since a page with a toc has at least two navs. Put role="list" on the ul, because the reset only removes list markers where that role says the list is decorative. The link for the section being read carries aria-current="true"; toc.js moves it, and a page that ships the mark in its HTML is correct without the module. The module owns aria-current on these links: it sets and clears the value "true" and strips any other aria-current an author puts on a toc link. Every link points at an id on this page, so the list works with no script at all.

events.name: yeti:current
events.description: Dispatched on the .toc when the mark moves to another link.
